reduction_concentration.evidence: The pellet was resuspended at 1 × 109 cells/mL in ice-cold Buffer I (water containing 0.1 μM 1-chloro-3-tosylamido-7-amino-2-heptone (TLCK), 1 mM benzamidine, 1 mM phenyl-methyl sulfonyl fluoride (PMSF), 1 μg/mL leupeptin, and 1 μg/mL aprotinin), and hypotonic lysis was allowed to proceed for 10 min on ice (NB, T. brucei cells spontaneously lyse under these conditions).

Cells were centrifuged at 1200g for 10 min at 4. The resulting pellet was washed in phosphate buffered saline, centrifuged as above, and resuspended in ice-cold lysis buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 1 mM DTT, 60 mM MgCl2, 0.2% (v/v) NP40, complete EDTA-free protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche), phosphatase Inhibitor Cocktail II (Calbiochem)).
